from PIL import Image
from scipy import ndimage
for c in (0,1):
 o=robot.observe(camera=c); Image.fromarray(o['rgb']).save(f'/app/output/scene_now_{c}.png')
 rgb=o['rgb'].astype(int); d=o['depth_m']; K=o['intrinsic']; T=o['camera_to_world']; r=o['robot']
 print('\nCAM',c,'tcp',r['tcp_position'],'q',r['joint_positions'],'grip',r['gripper_positions'])
 # detect brown/orange surfaces, exclude image white background; print connected component centers
 mask=(rgb[:,:,0]>75)&(rgb[:,:,0]<230)&(rgb[:,:,0]>rgb[:,:,1]*1.05)&(rgb[:,:,1]>rgb[:,:,2]*1.03)&(d<2.0)
 lab,n=ndimage.label(mask)
 objs=[]
 for i in range(1,n+1):
  yy,xx=np.where(lab==i)
  if len(xx)>=4:
   u=int(np.mean(xx)); v=int(np.mean(yy)); z=float(np.median(d[yy,xx]))
   cam=np.array([(u-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0],(v-K[1,2])*z/K[1,1],z,1.]); w=T@cam
   objs.append((len(xx),u,v,z,w[:3].round(3).tolist(),rgb[v,u].tolist()))

for c in (0,1):

    r=o['robot']; K,T,d=o['intrinsic'],o['camera_to_world'],o['depth_m']
    pc=np.linalg.inv(T)@np.r_[r['tcp_position'],1.]; uv=K@pc[:3]; uv=uv[:2]/uv[2]

    lab,n=ndimage.label(mask); comps=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        yy,xx=np.where(lab==i)
        if len(xx)>25:
            u=int(np.mean(xx)); v=int(np.mean(yy)); z=float(np.median(d[yy,xx]))
            w=T@np.array([(u-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0],(v-K[1,2])*z/K[1,1],z,1.])
            comps.append((len(xx),u,v,round(z,3),np.round(w[:3],3).tolist(),rgb[v,u].tolist()))
    print('components',sorted(comps,reverse=True)[:10])
print('STATUS',robot.status())
